user.title: Samsung TV (Tizen)
user.description: Enter the IP address of the TV. The TV must be on and on the same network as Home Assistant.

data_description.host: Tip: give the TV a fixed IP in your router.

pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description: Press **Submit**, then within 45 seconds choose **Allow** on the popup that appears on the TV ({host}).

error.cannot_connect: TV not reachable. Make sure it is on and the IP address is correct.
error.auth_denied: The TV refused the connection. Try again and choose Allow (or remove Home Assistant from the TV's device list under Settings > General > External device manager > Device connection manager).
error.pairing_failed: No answer from the TV in time. Try again and accept the popup on the TV.

init.title: Wake-on-LAN
init.description: Used to turn the TV on when it is fully off. On the TV, enable Settings > General > Network > Expert settings > Power on with mobile.
